title: The Fake Locker
author: Rafael Nakamura
blurb: Wendell Pemberton, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
